player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} deg {num_rounds} n tuzzya n IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Yal tuzzya, ḍruḍ wuḍuḍ gar {min_guess} ed {max_guess}.
Mi d-kecmen wuḍuḍen, ameɣlal d (2/3)x(amḍan n wuḍuḍen),
ed amiraz i wuḍuḍ-is i qrib ɣer ameɣlal i rebḥa tuzzya-nni.
ɛiwed s wuḍuḍ-ik s tseɣlint '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Asenfar ur nṣeḥḥa ara; ma ulac aɣilif, rnu-d aswir am akken d [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ad d-tiniḍ belli ilaq ad yili gar {min_guess} akked {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Amseqdar 0 tekcem {guess0}; Amseqdar 1 tekcem {guess1}. Merra, Amenzu yella d : {target}.

outcome.p0_wins: Amyur n 0 yerbeḥ ugar n yiberdan.
